items.headline: Anna Nordqvist Retires
items.text: Three-time major leader Anna Nordqvist ends her LPGA Tour career after the FM Championship to focus on health, family, and her Solheim Cup role.

items.headline: LIV Golf Funding Uncertain
items.text: LIV Golf's $300 million funding faces threats as Patrick Reed explores options and Bryson DeChambeau plans to focus on majors after his 2026 contract ends.
